$ tool
DESCRIPTION
  Project tools

USAGE
  tool <subcommand> [flags]

FLAGS
  --verbose, -v       Verbose output
  --profile string    Profile name

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                                                          Show help information
  --version, -v                                                       Show version information
  --wizard                                                            Start wizard mode for a command
  --completions <bash|zsh|fish|powershell|sh|pwsh>                    Print shell completion script (choices: bash, zsh, fish, powershell, sh, pwsh)
  --log-level <all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none>    Sets the minimum log level (choices: all, trace, debug, info, warn, warning, error, fatal, none)
  --dry                                                               Show the plan
  --trace                                                             Send spans, logs and metrics to OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT

SUBCOMMANDS
  greet     Prints a greeting
  sum       Adds
  remote    Manage remotes
error: Help requested

$ tool --help
(stdout of $ tool)

$ tool greet --help
DESCRIPTION

FLAGS

  --times, -n string    How many times
  --level [=string]     

INHERITED FLAGS
  --verbose, -v       Verbose output
  --profile string    Profile name

  --help, -h                                                          Show help information
  --version, -v                                                       Show version information
  --wizard                                                            Start wizard mode for a command
  --completions <bash|zsh|fish|powershell|sh|pwsh>                    Print shell completion script (choices: bash, zsh, fish, powershell, sh, pwsh)
  --log-level <all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none>    Sets the minimum log level (choices: all, trace, debug, info, warn, warning, error, fatal, none)

  --version, -v                                                       Show version information

  --completions <bash|zsh|fish|powershell|sh|pwsh>                    Print shell completion script (choices: bash, zsh, fish, powershell, sh, pwsh)

$ tool --version
tool v1.0.0

$ tool greet Ada
greet level=None loud=false name=Ada times=1

$ tool -v --profile p greet -l --times 3 --level Ada
greet level=Some(auto) loud=true name=Ada times=3

$ tool greet --level=x Ada
greet level=Some(x) loud=false name=Ada times=1

$ tool greet --loud --loud Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Invalid value for flag --loud: "2 occurrences". Expected: at most 1 value

$ tool greet -n 2 --times 3 Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Invalid value for flag --times: "2 occurrences". Expected: at most 1 value

$ tool greet --level --level=b Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Invalid value for flag --level: "2 occurrences". Expected: at most 1 value

$ tool --verbose -v greet Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Invalid value for flag --verbose: "2 occurrences". Expected: at most 1 value

$ tool --profile a greet --profile b Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Invalid value for flag --profile: "2 occurrences". Expected: at most 1 value

$ tool sum --tag a --tag b 1 2
sum numbers=[1,2] tag=[a,b]

$ tool sum 1 x
(stdout of $ tool sum -h)
error: Invalid value for argument <numbers>: "x". Expected: not an Int: x

$ tool greet --times x Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Invalid value for flag --times: "x". Expected: not an Int: x

$ tool greet --=x
greet level=None loud=false name=--=x times=1

$ tool --=x
(stdout of $ tool)
error: Unknown subcommand "--=x" for "tool"

$ tool greet -ln=3 Ada
greet level=None loud=true name=Ada times=3

$ tool greet --no-loud Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet Ada)

$ tool greet --no-loud=true Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Invalid value for flag --loud: "true". Expected: omit the value and use --no-loud=true by itself to set --loud to false

$ tool greet --no-loud yes Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Invalid value for flag --loud: "yes". Expected: omit the value and use --no-loud by itself to set --loud to false

$ tool greet --no-times Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Unrecognized flag: --no-times in command tool greet

$ tool greet --lod Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Unrecognized flag: --lod in command tool greet

  Did you mean this?
    --loud

$ tool greet --times
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Missing value for flag --times. Expected: string

$ tool greet
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Missing required argument: name

$ tool greet Ada Bob
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Unexpected positional argument: "Bob"

$ tool gret
(stdout of $ tool)
error: Unknown subcommand "gret" for "tool"

  Did you mean this?
    greet

$ tool remote
DESCRIPTION
  Manage remotes

USAGE
  tool remote <subcommand> [flags]

FLAGS
  --remote-name string    The remote

INHERITED FLAGS
  --verbose, -v       Verbose output
  --profile string    Profile name

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                                                          Show help information
  --version, -v                                                       Show version information
  --wizard                                                            Start wizard mode for a command
  --completions <bash|zsh|fish|powershell|sh|pwsh>                    Print shell completion script (choices: bash, zsh, fish, powershell, sh, pwsh)
  --log-level <all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none>    Sets the minimum log level (choices: all, trace, debug, info, warn, warning, error, fatal, none)
  --dry                                                               Show the plan
  --trace                                                             Send spans, logs and metrics to OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
  --force                                                             Skip checks

SUBCOMMANDS
  add    Add one
error: Help requested

$ tool remote add u
add url=u

$ tool remote --remote-name up add u
(stdout of $ tool remote add u)

$ tool remote --force add u
force at tool remote add

$ tool greet --force Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Unrecognized flag: --force in command tool greet

$ tool --dry greet Ada
dry at tool greet

$ tool --dry --dry greet Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Invalid value for flag --dry: "2 occurrences". Expected: at most 1 value

$ tool --dry=maybe greet Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Invalid value for flag --dry: "maybe". Expected "true" | "yes" | "on" | "1" | "y" | "false" | "no" | "off" | "0" | "n"

$ tool --log-level debug greet Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet Ada)

$ tool --log-level bogus greet Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Invalid value for flag --log-level: "bogus". Expected: "all" | "trace" | "debug" | "info" | "warn" | "warning" | "error" | "fatal" | "none"

$ tool --log-level info --log-level warn greet Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Invalid value for flag --log-level: "2 occurrences". Expected: at most 1 value

$ tool --log-level
(stdout of $ tool)
error: Missing value for flag --log-level. Expected: all | trace | debug | info | warn | warning | error | fatal | none

$ tool --completions nope
(stdout of $ tool)
error: Invalid value for flag --completions: "nope". Expected: "bash" | "zsh" | "fish" | "powershell" | "sh" | "pwsh"

$ tool --trace=nah greet Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Invalid value for flag --trace: "nah". Expected "true" | "yes" | "on" | "1" | "y" | "false" | "no" | "off" | "0" | "n"

$ tool --trace --trace greet Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Invalid value for flag --trace: "2 occurrences". Expected: at most 1 value

$ tool --wizard=maybe greet Ada
(stdout of $ tool greet --help)
error: Invalid value for flag --wizard: "maybe". Expected "true" | "yes" | "on" | "1" | "y" | "false" | "no" | "off" | "0" | "n"
